blogs.title: Finetuning Giant Language Models on a Single GPU: How QLoRA Makes It Possible
blogs.description: An introductory post that demystifies the core problem of memory consumption in LLM finetuning and explains how QLoRA’s combination of 4‑bit NormalFloat quantization, double quantization, and paged optimizers shrinks a 65‑billion‑parameter model to fit into a 48 GB GPU without losing performance.

blogs.title: Inside NF4: The Information‑Optimal 4‑Bit Data Type Behind QLoRA
blogs.description: A deep‑dive into the NormalFloat (NF4) quantization scheme, why normal‑distributed weights are a perfect fit, and how NF4 outperforms traditional 4‑bit floats and integers on real‑world benchmarks.

blogs.title: Low‑Rank Adapters Meet Quantized Weights: The LoRA Tricks That Recover Full‑Precision Accuracy
blogs.description: Explains the LoRA adapter mechanism, why adding adapters to every transformer layer matters for QLoRA, and how back‑propagating through frozen 4‑bit weights restores the accuracy of a full‑precision finetune.

blogs.title: Training the Guanaco Chatbot Family: From 7B to 65B with One GPU
blogs.description: Showcases the practical workflow used to build the open‑source Guanaco models, covering dataset choices, hyperparameter tweaks, training time estimates, and tips for reproducing state‑of‑the‑art chatbots on consumer hardware.

blogs.title: Evaluating Chatbots Without Paying for Human Labels: GPT‑4 vs. Humans in QLoRA Benchmarks
blogs.description: Analyzes the paper’s novel evaluation pipeline—pairwise Elo tournaments, GPT‑4 scoring, and human annotations—discusses where they agree or diverge, and offers guidance on using model‑based evaluation responsibly.

blogs.title: Beyond Benchmarks: What QLoRA Reveals About Instruction Data Quality vs. Quantity
blogs.description: Summarizes the authors’ findings that a small high‑quality instruction set (e.g., OASST1) beats massive but noisy datasets for chatbot performance, and explains how QLoRA enabled this large‑scale comparative study.

blogs.title: The Limits of 4‑Bit Finetuning: Failure Cases, Biases, and Future Directions
blogs.description: Presents a balanced view of QLoRA’s shortcomings—mathematical errors, secret‑keeping failures, and remaining bias concerns—while outlining research avenues such as 3‑bit quantization and alternative PEFT methods.
